terminal_rule.frozen_condition: After the one authorized in-place R3.1 repair, any independently observed unauthorized ADMITTED result, incorrectly accepted VALID_EMPTY_NOT_ADMITTED result, validator exception, unexecuted contract field type, aliased mutator, or non-exact v0.5 Evidence carrier triggers TERMINAL_P1A_AUTHORITY_CHAIN_BLOCK.
trigger_basis: Multiple unauthorized candidate mutations were independently observed as ADMITTED.
A zero-byte candidate with a nonstandard payload hash was observed as VALID_EMPTY_NOT_ADMITTED.
The implementer explicitly reported that Transform, Coverage, and Tip pinning remained incomplete.
The implementer explicitly reported that independent mutator preservation remained incomplete.

failures.mutation: Replace transform_digest with an arbitrary value and preserve candidate self-consistency.
Replace no-activity proof_ref and proof_digest with arbitrary values and preserve candidate self-consistency.
Supply an arbitrary external tip whose commitment time is in the future.
Supply an exact-field v0.5 Evidence carrier whose available_at is later than decision_time.
Set the raw record payload_sha256 to an integer and re-sign the containing objects.
Use different payload SHA-256 values in ValidatorInput and the admitted raw record.
Use payload_byte_length zero with a payload hash other than SHA-256 of empty bytes.
Use an empty receipt_id in a nonempty admitted candidate.
Use an integer admission_id in a nonempty admitted candidate.
Use the forbidden ACTIVE-G1 alias in candidate identity data.
Use the forbidden plain Application Support alias in candidate identity data.

passed_control.interpretation: Malformed-contract totality was corrected, but this isolated control does not close the authority-chain failures.

findings: Transform, proof, and external-tip values remain candidate-authorized rather than contract-pinned exact authority objects.
Declared field types and cross-object bindings are not completely enforced by the executable validator.
Payload identity is not closed from ValidatorInput through the raw record and admission chain.
Zero-byte EMPTY semantics are not bound to SHA-256 of empty bytes.
Forbidden active-G1 aliases remain incompletely normalized and rejected.
The one authorized R3.1 repair did not preserve the required independently executable mutator closure.

permitted_actions: Preserve the six bound R3.1 draft artifacts unchanged.
Perform read-only governance reporting about this terminal block.
stage_disposition.reopening_rule: Any reopening requires a new explicit user-authorized program-level Sol decision. This record grants no reopening, repair, replacement-lane, or implementation permission.

claim_boundary.maximum_positive_claim: The bound P1A R3.1 static reference candidate fails its frozen authority-chain acceptance contract and is terminally blocked under the previously authorized single-repair stop rule.
